title: AMC 8 Practice: Border Tiles on a Floor — 40 Blue, 80 White
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on the dimensions of a rectangular floor from its border and inside tile counts, solved with a list and an edge-tile count. (Level 4 of 5)
A floor has a ring of blue tiles around the edge and white tiles inside. Can two counts tell us its shape?
We make a list of floors, then use the edge to get length plus width. Then try a new floor yourself!
